lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6V2 (reduced formula Mg3V) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 119), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Mg and V centers adopt 12-neighbor, close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg is coordinated by 8 Mg and 4 V, while V is coordinated by 12 Mg, with neighbor distances ranging from 2.995 to 3.245 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between V-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
